description: PRO. Active banks in a state ranked by assets or weakest ROA — for B2B sales, vendors and counterparty screens. Results include `status` (`ok` or `lookup_failed`), `retrieved_at` (ISO 8601 UTC, when this result was produced) and `source_updated_at` (when the FDIC data was fetched, including cache hits). A failed FDIC lookup returns `status: lookup_failed` and is distinct from zero matches (`status: ok`).
